_doc: Skills (T-0071, docs/design/people.md). Levels 0..max_level, one level per xp_per_level XP. XP comes from practice: interactions' skill_xp (per hour), and work (work_xp_per_hour in the job's skill). effects: finish_bonus_per_level scales an interaction's finish_needs for its finish_skill (cooking: better meals); charisma_per_level adds to the logit of social success; performance_per_level adds to performance after each shift worked to the end (the job's skill); interview_per_level adds to the interview chance (the job's skill).
